content.value_statement: Complex diagram work often needs repeatable vector files and reliable exports. This skill guides LibreOffice Draw creation, conversion, and automation workflows.
actual_capabilities: Create new ODG drawings from templates or scripted workflows.
Convert ODG drawings to SVG, PDF, PNG, JPG, and related formats.
Use LibreOffice headless commands for repeatable local exports.
Automate drawing creation with Python UNO examples.
Organize diagrams with layers, named objects, labels, and reusable templates.
limitations: Requires LibreOffice and related command-line tools to be installed locally.
Conversion quality depends on source files, fonts, and export filters.
Python UNO automation needs a configured LibreOffice listener.
It does not replace manual review of technical drawings or final exports.

use_cases.title: Prepare Web Vector Exports
use_cases.description: Convert ODG artwork into SVG or PNG assets for web and product documentation.

use_cases.title: Maintain Diagram Source Files
use_cases.description: Create editable ODG diagrams and export PDF versions for manuals and release notes.

use_cases.title: Batch Convert Drawing Libraries
use_cases.description: Use headless LibreOffice commands to export many drawings into required delivery formats.

prompt_templates.title: Convert One Drawing
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the draw skill to convert my ODG file to PDF. Ask for the file path and output folder before running commands.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Flowchart Template
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me design an ODG flowchart template with layers, named shapes, and export steps for SVG and PDF.

prompt_templates.title: Automate Batch Exports
prompt_templates.prompt: Plan a LibreOffice Draw batch export workflow for a folder of ODG files. Include validation checks and safe command prompts.

prompt_templates.title: Build a UNO Drawing Workflow
prompt_templates.prompt: Draft a Python UNO workflow that creates an ODG diagram from structured steps. Include listener setup assumptions and error checks.

output_examples.input: Convert project architecture.odg to SVG and PDF.
output_examples.output: A safe conversion plan with required paths, confirmation steps, and checks for generated files.

output_examples.input: Create a reusable flowchart in LibreOffice Draw.
output_examples.output: A template plan with layers, shape naming, connector style, label rules, and export formats.

output_examples.input: Fix low quality PNG export from an ODG file.
output_examples.output: Troubleshooting guidance that checks page size, export resolution, filter settings, fonts, and visual comparison.

best_practices: Keep editable ODG files in version control with exported files generated separately.
Confirm file paths and output formats before running any local commands.
Test exports in the target viewer before sharing final diagrams.
anti_patterns: Running batch conversions without checking the working directory first.
Using bitmap exports as the only source for diagrams that need later edits.
Starting a LibreOffice listener on a shared host without access controls.

faq.question: Does this skill require LibreOffice?
faq.answer: Yes. LibreOffice must be installed for command-line conversion and Draw automation workflows.

faq.question: Can it create diagrams from scratch?
faq.answer: Yes. It can guide ODG drawing setup, layers, shapes, labels, and export steps.

faq.question: Can it convert SVG to ODG?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill includes LibreOffice workflows for converting SVG files into editable ODG drawings.

faq.question: Does it run commands automatically?
faq.answer: Commands should be reviewed and confirmed before execution, especially installs and process-control steps.

faq.question: Can it use Python automation?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes Python UNO examples for creating and saving Draw documents.

faq.question: Is it suitable for final engineering drawings?
faq.answer: It can prepare files, but final technical drawings still need domain review and validation.
